# Design DNA in Any chat assistant without skills (instruction kit)

<!-- generated by python install.py docs from hosts/registry/instructions.json -->

## Install

### Instruction kit for project instructions, custom GPTs, Gems, spaces and similar

Method: instruction kit (fallback) — not native; a labelled fallback. Capability: **Instructions only (fallback)**. No code runs. The assistant follows the Design DNA method by eye. Nothing is measured, rendered or verified, and every value is an estimate that it must label as one.

1. Download design-dna-instructions-kit.zip and unzip it.
2. Paste INSTRUCTIONS.md into the assistant's custom instructions (project, GPT, Gem or space).
3. Attach the files in knowledge/ where the assistant accepts reference files.
4. Expect labelled estimates, not measurements: see the capability table.

Package: [design-dna-instructions-kit.zip](https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna/releases/latest/download/design-dna-instructions-kit.zip) (or `python install.py package --target instructions-kit`). It is small by design, roughly 40 KB of instructions and references; it runs no code. A file of a few bytes is a failed download.

## Prerequisites

- An assistant that accepts custom instructions

## Try it

Attach a poster or social post and ask: *Scan this design with Design DNA and save it as "Spring Launch".* Then: *Change only the headline to "Made for every day" and keep everything else.*
